description: This file defines the Image model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework, providing functionality for resizing images, including file existence checks, image processing, cache management, and URL generation.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Provides image resizing capabilities within the Opencart framework, handling image cache creation, format validation, and URL generation.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to specified dimensions, creating a cached version if necessary, and returns the URL to the resized image.
